items.headline: Georgia clinches SEC title game berth with win at South Carolina
items.description: Nate Frazier ran for 94 yards and two touchdowns, and No. 1 Georgia clinched a spot in the final SEC championship game with a victory over South Carolina on Saturday night.

items.headline: Frazier's two TDs lift No. 1 Georgia into SEC title game with 34-6 win at South Carolina
items.description: — Georgia has been to the Southeastern Championship game so often, coach Kirby Smart didn't even know he'll make history with his latest appearance — his sixth in a row.
